text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Deep teal zip work jacket with two flap chest pockets over light blue thin-striped open-collar shirt and white crew-neck tee, faded medium-blue wide jeans, black smooth leather ankle boots.. Add ONLY these accessories: Large dark teal leather bucket tote with two long straps, curved panel seams and hanging adjustment strap; Cream leather belt with small silver rectangular buckle; Fine silver chain necklace with a small plain pendant. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 3 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Large dark teal leather bucket tote with two long straps, curved panel seams and hanging adjustment strap; 2. Cream leather belt with small silver rectangular buckle; 3. Fine silver chain necklace with a small plain pendant. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
